description: Schema definition for Product Item Category entity that classifies and organizes product items

id.desc: Unique identifier for the product item category

company.desc: The company name associated with the product item category; references the Companies schema's name field

code.desc: Optional code for identifying the product item category

displayName.desc: User-friendly display name for the product item category

lastModifiedDateTime.desc: Timestamp when the product item category was last modified
